name: Renoir Nishi-Nippori Daiichi
nameJa: 喫茶室ルノアール 西日暮里第一店
description: A spacious 100-plus-seat Renoir branch steps from Nishi-Nippori station with free Wi-Fi, customer power outlets, and roomy seating that suits long work sessions.

name: Renoir Nippori East Exit
nameJa: 喫茶室ルノアール 日暮里東口店
description: This Renoir branch right by Nippori's east exit pairs multiple free Wi-Fi networks with seat-side power outlets, making it a reliable spot for extended remote work.

name: Beck's Coffee Shop Nishi-Nippori
nameJa: ベックスコーヒーショップ 西日暮里店
description: An inexpensive fully non-smoking station cafe with shared Beck's Wi-Fi and roughly nine twin-outlet spots spread across bench seating for around fifty guests.

name: Excelsior Caffe Nippori
nameJa: エクセルシオール カフェ 日暮里店
description: A large 116-seat Excelsior close to Nippori station whose official listing confirms power outlets, with free Wi-Fi and early-to-late hours convenient for working.

name: Doutor Coffee Machiya-Ekimae
nameJa: ドトールコーヒーショップ 町屋駅前店
description: A budget-friendly Doutor at the Machiya station entrance whose official page lists both free Wi-Fi and power outlets, opening early for morning work.

name: Tully's Coffee Nippori
nameJa: タリーズコーヒー 日暮里店
description: A compact Tully's near Nippori station offering Tully's Wi-Fi; a work-cafe roundup reports usable outlets, though one directory leaves outlet count unlisted.

name: Bliss Coffee Nishi-Nippori
description: A small independent cafe with distinctive decor a couple of minutes from Nippori station, reported to offer free Wi-Fi and power outlets for its roughly nineteen seats.

name: Tomoroyu Nippori
nameJa: 昔ながらの喫茶店 友路有 日暮里店
description: A Showa-retro-style coffee house near Nippori's south side reported to provide free Wi-Fi and power outlets, suited to quiet solo work.
